## What's new

The Updates screen offers two ways to install a newer ChaOS, and games,
music, saves and settings stay with either:

- Update: only ChaOS's own files the release changed, a few MB, copied into
  place before restarting - offered when the release's system underneath is
  the card's;
- Full Install: the whole system, installed at the next boot, and every one
  of ChaOS's files copied fresh from it (the card's ChaOS/VERSION is removed
  so init.d/tortos copies them all). Always offered, the version already
  installed too, to repair a card whose ChaOS files have gone wrong.

Try Again repeats whichever failed. The README explains both.

---

ChaOS 0.9.3 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v0.9.3-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.1.1](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.1.1) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v0.9.3-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
